items.name: powdered milk
items.note: optional, gives a more dairy and very sweet flavor - if you don't add it, replace with flour

steps.text: Mix the eggs with the sugar.
Then add the melted butter and mix.
Add the Milo and powdered milk.
Add the flour and salt and mix until combined.
Prepare your molds with the recipe below and add the mixture. Bake in a preheated oven at 180 C for 35 minutes or until a knife inserted comes out clean.
Extra tip: so it doesn't stick, mix 1 teaspoon of cocoa powder with 1 teaspoon of butter or neutral oil and spread this mixture on your mini cocottes from @victoriacocinacastiron.
Tip 2: a little raw mixture and add it when it comes out of the oven. If you prefer not to add the raw mixture you can make a mixture of Milo and heavy cream as a sauce.
You'll see your addiction to this recipe ❤️‍🩹 and hopefully you can make it for your mom (there's nothing they like more than what we make with our hands).
